endpoint_rules.activation: Original code-owned CURRENT_PROFILE object supplied to createRegistry, checked by object identity.

endpoint_rules.composite_boundary: All 42 current element endpoint types are represented by exact B.5 cells. Group contents, instance containment, lifecycle, cycles and whole-model conformance remain unassessed. Eight Product/Plateau aggregation/composition triples retain explicit UNKNOWN scope qualifications.

concept_endpoints.aggregation_composition_any_junction: source-scope UNKNOWN, distinct from the eight ordinary-element cases

junctions.graph_scope: Bounded degree/family, terminal permission, explicit containing-role applicability, junction-end multiplicity and coverage diagnostics; no whole-model or execution semantics.

viewpoints.current_behavior: Reusable project-owned stakeholder/concern/purpose/content definitions; exact concrete-type selection; explicit view binding; non-destructive drawing projection; create/update/bind/delete commands with existing transaction history; complete native definitions, bindings and hidden data roundtrip with viewpointFormat: 1 exactly when definitions exist.
viewpoints.qualification: One current native format/runtime; no normative permission authority or concern-satisfaction judgment; manually authored layout. Actual Electron/native-dialog and Windows acceptance UNRUN; independent persistence acceptance HOLD. Browser QA is optional development evidence.

customization.current_behavior: Model-owned reusable typed profiles, seven primitive types plus bounded Structure/List values, optional live defaults, explicit per-concept overrides, multiple named specialization labels, five transactional commands and exact native/history behavior.
customization.qualification: Local bounded encoding choices; not new metamodel types, trusted rules, arbitrary restrictions, executable profiles, uploaded graphics or standards-based exchange. No full-language or desktop acceptance claim.

gaps.needed: Full grammar and real-world instance-cardinality semantics remain unverified. Junction-attached-end applicability is separately assessed without changing raw text.
gaps.current_behavior: Optional sourceMultiplicity and targetMultiplicity raw strings up to 128 local UTF-16 units; absent/empty/asterisk remain distinct. Separate assessMultiplicity diagnostics do not block structurally valid saves or change normative UNKNOWN. A present field at a junction end produces a separate applicability failure; no field is removed.
gaps.next_increment: No cardinality/edge-count inference from raw annotations; see separate concept/junction scope.

gaps.current_behavior: The fixed shared canvas/palette/legend mapping has bounded corrected boxed forms for Device, Node, ApplicationComponent, BusinessInterface, ApplicationInterface, TechnologyInterface, Plateau, Equipment, Facility, Service, Process, Function, Event, Role, Collaboration, Path, Location, BusinessActor, Stakeholder, Driver, Assessment, Goal, Outcome, Principle, Requirement, SystemSoftware, CommunicationNetwork, DistributionNetwork, Artifact, Material, Resource, Capability, ValueStream, CourseOfAction and WorkPackage. BusinessObject, Product, DataObject, Value, Deliverable and corrected dashed Grouping retain valid icon-form topology; Meaning now adds the two detached lower-left bubbles to its unchanged cloud. Original local geometry is used; this is not source-artwork equivalence or complete iconography acceptance.
gaps.needed: Full support for the displayed boxed/icon repertoire remains a separate open standard-support gap, including boxed alternatives for the seven valid icon forms and standalone alternatives for the implemented boxed forms. A valid single fixed form does not establish support for both.

default_form_inventory.qualification: Disjoint local source/render default-form inventory: 35 boxed and 7 icon forms. Not a conformance score, complete alternative-form support, native visual acceptance or release readiness.

source_form_boundary.qualification: The clauses jointly support the illustrated notation repertoire obligation. Applying that general obligation to each illustrated pair is a textual synthesis, not a quoted per-type selector requirement. They prescribe no selector, per-occurrence field, UI or persistence mechanism. A modeler may use one valid form or mix forms. Owner-scoped release 1.0 defers alternate-form support without erasing this full-standard gap.

gaps.current_behavior: No Linked.Archi SHACL bundle is imported into the rule engine.
gaps.needed: The 1764-cell 42-type endpoint record is independently checked against C260; it does not adopt either SHACL bundle or resolve their unreviewed conflicts.
